title: Shams by Group of Friends
desc: A group of pro Qari friends recite Surah Shams with their hearts out. Is not that a friend cycle which we wish to have?

title: Najm by Mishary
desc: When Mishary decides to recite Najm in leanback style

title: Ibrahim by Mishary
desc: The father son emotional situation recited with the emotion it needed by Mishary.

title: Najm by Jamil (?)
desc: Tow handsome black guys go on a heavenly trip to recite Najm last verses in a style never heard before. When prophet completed Najm, even Kafirs went to Sajda, these guys tries to explore why with melody.

title: Mulk by Mishary
desc: This is one the best recitation of Surah Mulk with almost all verses getting exact emotion it needed by non other than Mishary. Slow, perfect to play before going to sleep.

title: Rahman by Mishary
desc: There are many recitations of Rahman by Mishary, but this one is the slow and relaxed and doing justice to the meanings of verses. Euphoric when Jannah comes, dreaded when Naar comes etc. Perfect to listen after Fajr/waking up.

title: Verses of Sabr from Baqara by Mishary
desc: I tried to find the best recitation which do justice to meaning, by far this is the one. I may be wrong.

title: Ayatul Kursi by Mishary in almost single breath
desc: Old viral burried voice of Mishary reciting Ayatul Qursi in almost single breath.

title: Waqia by Mishary
desc: I found this version of Waqia recitation of Mishary the best one.

title: Qalam by Boy in Jail
desc: We don't support crime, whoever does it, even a Hafij. But there is nothing wrong admiring a boy reciting Quran in jail. I don't know the crime he is in jail for.

title: Hud : Mishary
desc: You see a killer coming to kill your son, you explain and call your son to come near you for safety, but your son denies and stays there and gets killed. Can you hold tear? That is the story of Noah described by Allah in Suarh Hud. Hud mainly shows father-son and flood description. While Surah Nuh mainly describes Noah's call to people, how people tormented him and why Noah asked for flood.
